P.text: `stakingLimit` limits the total staked amount in the system; `netStaked` is calculated as `(totalStaked + rewardsAmount - totalClaimed)` in the `stake` function

I.text: `netStaked` should account for `totalSlashing`/`slashedAmount`, since slashing removes HYPE from the protocol and makes space for new deposits
I.evidence_quote: There is no `slashedAmount` which represents total amount ever slashed in the protocol. Total slashing affects staking limit because it "removes" `HYPE` from the protocol making space for new deposits.

V.text: `netStaked` is overestimated, so the `stakingLimit` check can show no space for new deposits even when real HYPE in the protocol allows additional deposits, preventing potential new deposits
V.evidence_quote: `netStaked` is incorrectly calculated in the `stake` function, overestimating the real total `HYPE` amount in the system, preventing potential new deposits.
